name: Bypass human verification
description: The adversary is trying to bypass CAPTCHA verifications, which is harder from the Tor network.

subtechniques.name: Automated CAPTCHA solving
subtechniques.description: Automated CAPTCHA solving tools might be used to bypass human verification from Tor, which are more frequent and harder to solve.

subtechniques.name: Set accessibility cookie
subtechniques.description: Accessibility cookies might be used to bypass hCaptcha’s.

procedures.name: Buster
procedures.description: Buster is a browser extension which helps you to solve difficult CAPTCHAs by completing reCAPTCHA audio challenges using speech recognition. Challenges are solved by clicking on the extension button at the bottom of the reCAPTCHA widget. https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/buster-captcha-solver-for/mpbjkejclgfgadiemmefgebjfooflfhl

procedures.name: Wayback Machine onion service as JS-free clearnet proxy
procedures.description: The Wayback Machine (archive.org) operates an onion service that serves archived clearnet pages without requiring JavaScript. By appending a URL after /web/, users can access static sites anonymously without relying on Tor exit nodes and without JavaScript execution risk. Trust is shifted to archive.org, which cannot obtain usable metrics when connecting via the onion service.
